record.edic_text:
3052 logios {log'-ee-os}

from 3056; TDNT - 4:136,505; adj

AV - eloquent 1; 1

1) learned, a man of letters, skilled in literature and the arts,
   esp. versed in history and the antiquities
2) skilled in speech, eloquent
3) rational, wise
